Been going to this Vet hospital for years my puppy almost died of parvo & he saved her this time took my moms puppy very sick that she took to 2 other vets &no changes got worst etc took her to Dr Miller & he looked at her n immediately put puppy on IV meds something the other clinics said my mom puppy didn’t need just gave her 2 meds to give by mouth & sent us home with puppy that didn’t want to even walk so Dr Milker kept her by next day she doing so much better walking &responding his staff is so professional friendly calls us directly for updates he is amazing highly highly recommend him he shows & cares so much

10 stars out of 5. That’s twice as nice for a great price. Houston veterinary hospital is the absolute cream of the crop. Their friendly staff is well informed and professional. Dr. Miller is exceptionally knowledgeable, experienced, and dedicated with thorough attention to detail. You can trust that your pets are in safe hands at HVH. I’ve seen Dr. Miller, HVH manager Brittany, and their staff work miracles where other veterinarians have fallen short. My poor dog was miserable for years with chronic allergies, skin/ear infections, etc. that other vets unfortunately never seemed to be able to properly treat no matter what. But the cream rises to the top ooo yeah, and after being treated by Dr. Miller, she’s practically a whole new dog looking livelier, happier, and healthier than ever before. THANK YOU HOUSTON VETERINARY HOSPITAL!
The doctor is very knowledgeable, exceptionally nice, and trustful. The staff is helpful and nice. Their prices are very reasonable. Highly recommend this place.

This place is a perfect example of "Don't judge a book by its cover."  The building looks sort of industrial on the outside, but the staff on the inside are caring and attentive.  Dr. Miller is fantastic.  And I don't say that lightly.  Our previous vet retired after he had been seeing our pets for 25 years, and I cried when he told us.  And between the time of his retirement and finally finding Dr. Miller, we went to a few places that had beautiful offices but didn't measure up clinically.  (My brother is also a vet, but he's in Indiana.  Nonetheless, he's my phone-a-friend when I want to make sure a new vet is on the right path, and he confirmed that Dr. Miller is definitely a keeper.) Good veterinary care is not cheap, so Houston Veterinary Hospital is not cheap.  But their prices are reasonable, and Dr. Miller and his staff try to make sure there are no surprises.  If you are looking for a doctor that will care about your pet as much as you do, you should definitely check this place out.

Very knowledgeable veterinary care. Dr Miller has been able to diagnose and treat where other vets have failed. I drive an hour just to bring my pets to him. I would highly recommend Houston veterinary hospital to anyone searching for care of their furry children.

I’m glad I found this Vet, only $40 for office visit, much less than most, however I wish ALL the procedures were discounted. Ya know your Pet (cat in this case) can’t say if it hurts or where it hurts or if stomach feels bad… it’s all a guessing came no matter who the Vet is. Mine might have pancreatic issues ( he prescribed pills seems to be working some), but she’s still not gaining weight. So he recommended surgery/biopsy then chemo for $2300. I know everyone has to make a living and Vets go thru years of training… it’s just a lot for most.  Honestly I’m not even sure no matter the cost if I’d move forward with this procedure, she 8 or 9 years old, it would be too stressful. She est and sleeps and pees and poos, I’ll just love her. …. But I do appreciate the discount office visit costs ( we had a few over the last fee months), and I appreciate his attentivenes, he listens well.Thanks.
Excellent service. Very fast and the staff were very friendly.
Excellent service. Dr. Miller and his staff 100% . Attentive, thorough and great with my dogs.
Love the staff great service. I appreciate everything they do.

I absolutely luv this place I’ve been coming here since my baby was 4 months , even though SummerReign my cane Corso gives the staff a run for their money… they remain sweet and kind to my baby girl … thank yall 🫶🏾 best in town

I cannot recommend Dr. Matt Sherwood and the team at H-Town Veterinary Specialists enough. My dog, Bruno, recently underwent a complex Right Elbow Arthroscopy and Ulnar Osteotomy to address elbow subluxation and severe bowing.
The entire staff was professional, empathetic, and communicative, which made a stressful time much easier to manage.
The post-operative instructions for Bruno’s recovery and crate rest were clear and easy to follow. We are very grateful for the high level of care he received. If your pet requires orthopedic surgery, this is the place to go.

This is the best Vet in town! They have the best prices and always so caring with our pets! We have been coming to this location since Dr Dayton was the vet and now we have the pleasure of working with Dr. Miller. The staff that works along side him are just as helpful and caring which is so hard to find. I'm grateful to the full team at Houston Veterinary Hospital. Thanks Ladies for always accommodating us with the appointments and the care you give our dog. Dr. Miller is so attentive with Diamond and goes above and beyond for providing care. He personally reaches out even after he has provided care to make sure she is improving. I'll forever be grateful for the help he has provided us even when we are out of state. He makes sure that Diamond has everything she needs. He has helped us get her medication even from Walgreens. That should tell you how dedicated and attentive he is. There is no other vet I feel as confident visiting than him. My family jas brought all other pets in our household as well. They are simply the best! I, one million percent recommend you give them a try! You won't regret it! Thank you Dr Miller and the rest of team for everything you've done for our doggo!

We had a very sick cat who was on her last legs, basically expected her to pass at any time.

Dr Miller spent a lot of time diagnosing our cat, putting out the options, including surgery and than offered an alternate regime of medicine for our cat.

The surgery had a 50% chance of success, a lot of pain and recovery for our 9 year old cat and a +$10k bill.

First night was hit or miss after the medicine. But our cat woke up the next day and has been improving every day since. She is almost back to normal.

Thank you Dr Miller for saving our cats life - great job. And recommending an alternative solution instead of the easy $$$$ solution.

Thank you
Dr. Miller is amazing! Houston Veterinary Hospital offers great service at an amazing value!
Caring and compassionate from the front door to the vet. So glad this vet was reccomended to me.
No doctors when needed here

Dr.Miller has cared for 3 of our family’s dogs. I have to say, the quality of care he gives and the kindness he shows is amazing. It doesn’t just stop with Dr.Miller, his whole team also does an exceptional job of providing you with timely information and showing empathy when you’re concerned about your dog. I’ve been to multiple vets and vet hospitals around the Houston area and I have to say I’ve never met a vet with his regard. He really is a great vet and their prices are extremely competitive! They are cheaper than Petco, which for a major corporation I was shocked by. Petco quoted me $4K for a procedure that costed us $540 with Dr.Miller.
My poodle has a broken leg and needed surgery. Dr is very knowledgeable and prices were very reasonable compared to other. 10/10 recommended!

This place was Very Compassionate and Caring I appreciate the Great Service they gave Us They helped out tremendously Dr was Very Nice They Gave My Dog a Diagnosis it came out Positive 😭😭 and I love the Place I just Really recommend admitting to 24/7 Walk in Pet Emergency Hospital But Yes I would Give them a Five Star ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Not Really for 24/7 Emergency Care for Our Fur Baby 😭🥹

Dr.miller is the most amazing and fantastic Veterinary Doctor ever. My dog Tinkerbell she is a toy chihuahua has not feeling well in the past week ago. I took her to see Dr.miller bc she had prolaped. Dr.miller saw her and diagnosed her with Prolapsed intussusception and I was worry and scared. But he save her life give her a second chance in life. I am forever grateful and blessed that i meet Dr.miller and he save her life. Thank you not only for saving tinkerbell but save me from losing my first dog. Thank you

Earlier this week, Dr. Miller cared for my two cats, Kevin and Sam, with the same attentiveness and expertise he’s shown while managing my mother’s cat, Chavela, who is terminally ill. His assessment of Chavela was impeccable—thorough, thoughtful, and deeply compassionate. He handled her with such care and concern, as if she were his own, and that level of empathy is something I’ll never forget.

I’m incredibly grateful to Dr. Miller and his staff. Their professionalism, warmth, and genuine love for animals shine through in every interaction. It’s rare to find a veterinarian who embodies both clinical excellence and emotional intelligence so seamlessly. We feel truly fortunate to have him guiding Chavela’s care and now caring for Kevin and Sam as well. Thank you for being a source of comfort and trust during such a tender time.

From Pearland, and Houston's Southside, Joann & Adelita Molina

My dog ​​was very sick. I had an appointment at 3:30. Due to traffic and four accidents on the road, I called to let them know I would be late. The woman told me I could only be 10 minutes late. I told her I would arrive at 4:00 because of the accidents. I was coming from Texas City and arrived at the clinic with my dog ​​almost dead, and they told me they wouldn't treat him. I begged her to help me because I didn't know what to do, and I asked if she wanted to charge me double. She said no. She told me if I wanted, I could go and hospitalize him somewhere else. She just gave me a piece of paper with directions and said it was my problem, not hers. Those people have no heart. If I could give them zero, I would.

Today had to send my cat Mischief to the Rainbow 🌈 bridge. Everyone was so wonderful. Mischief and I were treated with respect and reverence. I appreciate all the care we received. I was glad they offered cremation.

We’ve been going to Houston Veterinary Hospital for years and have always received fantastic care. Dr. Miller is kind, approachable, and has been with us every step of the way in caring for our senior girl, from annual checkups to ailments and even surgeries. We truly believe the excellent care provided by Dr. Miller and his team made a huge difference in her health and quality of life, helping us navigate her needs from adoption through her crossing of the rainbow bridge.

A special thank you to the front staff, who were always so patient with my many calls and consistently friendly and efficient during our visits. Their kindness never went unnoticed.

Even after moving to Cypress, we continued making the drive to HVH because of the level of care and expertise they provided, especially for our senior girl. We are deeply grateful for everything they did for her and for us.
Staff was so helpful

Dr.Miller takes his time to explain everything and gives you opportunities to ask questions. He also called us following the survey to make sure everything is going well.
The front desk always pick up and are very helpful. They respond to emails with questions regarding healing, pricing, etc.

We had a great experience from beginning to end and were a huge help during a stressful time with our pets injury.

This place was amazing, after struggling finding a place that was actually open and did not have a cut off time for patients, super fast service, staff was amazing and sweet. Clean and loved I was able to go in with my baby Ace. Payment plans available, Highly recommend.

This place was a very traumatizing experience and I believe this has happened in 2021 and it is something I cannot forget. Our family had a pug that got sick from Parvo and so we had to let our Dog spend the night in the clinic here.This was my sister’s dog, her name was sweetie.  Soon They kept updating my sister falsely stating she was “walking” and “getting better”  They’ve charged her 1,000s of dollars on shots and treatments they promised her would work. Sweetie was just becoming worse on the next visit.. she was skinny and had a hole pierced in her throat with a tube in her to eat and drink water. It was heartbreaking to witness. She could no longer hold her pee.. yet they kept again stating she’s getting better proceeding to let her suffer and continuing to charge her more bills.. if they knew she couldn’t make it , they should have said so. Instead they let sweetie suffer and suffer more and continued to charge. The worst experience in our life.

I also appreciate they let me know before any tests, etc. are done, how much it will cost - a courtesy I appreciate.  The 35 minutes it takes to drive there is totally worth it.

Heartless people, I DO NOT RECOMMEND IT. If you go to this place, make sure you arrive before 4 pm because they don't take patients after 4 pm. I arrived at 4:10 pm, my dog ​​was struggling to breathe and had blood coming from her nose. The person attending to me said, "I'm taking the last person at 4 pm." I felt awful; she didn't care about anything. She didn't even let me speak; she just sent me to another place about an hour away. Arrogant and heartless people. I should clarify that there was no one waiting; the place was empty. If she were even a little bit intelligent, she would have told me, "There are no veterinarians available. I'm very sorry, we can't help you at this time." But no, her arrogance and bad temper were all she showed. I couldn't see her name, but it was Saturday, February 15th. May God forgive her, because as far as I'm concerned, she can get hemorrhoids.

I had a terrible experience on Saturday. I took my little dog, Vaquita, to the clinic. She was very sick with kidney stones. They charged me almost 2,000 pesos to see if she could be saved. The nurse and the doctor said they had removed the stone and that she was going to get better, that I shouldn't worry. But this wasn't true. They deceived me by not helping my baby heal. She died Saturday night and died Sunday morning, around 3 pm. She suffered so much. It wouldn't have cost them anything to help me just once, but they care more about money than an animal.

I cannot recommend Hearthstone Animal Clinic and Dr. Pelton enough. As a resident of The Heights, just outside of downtown Houston, I’m surrounded by many veterinary options, yet I gladly make the trip across town to Hearthstone for the outstanding quality of care they provide. Every visit reaffirms that this decision is worth it.

His transparency about diagnoses, treatment options, and outcomes instills a sense of trust that is rare to find. He patiently answers all my questions, no matter how detailed and ensures I fully understand the care plan for my pet.

He and his team treat your pet as if it were their own, going above and beyond to make them feel safe and comfortable during what can often be a stressful experience. The care doesn’t stop after you leave the clinic; follow-up calls and check-ins are a testament to how much they truly care about their patients.

The quality of outcomes speaks for itself. My pet has consistently thrived under their care, and I have full confidence in Dr. Pelton and his clinic’s ability to handle any health concern that arises. I highly recommend choosing Hearthstone Animal Clinic for your pet’s care!
I just want to say thank you to Dr. Miller and his team, they are awesome. God bless.
